From Stdlib Require Orders OrdersEx OrdersAlt.

From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.

The Fast Global Context

The global context the extracted checker runs on: the filed units in one balanced map keyed by their whole paths (funits), the open frames each with the trie of its body so far (fstack), and the module bodies in a fast copy of the module layer (funit, ftrie, fentry) whose members are found by name in a balanced map, one lookup per component of a path.
Only the module layer is copied: terms, context entries, declarations and module expressions are Core's (exp, centry, ind_decl, record_decl, modexp). Each body is stored once, as a trie; no Core gmod is kept next to it.
The Core context is never built at run time. It appears in types and proofs only:
  • translate_unit and the like translate Core data into fast data; the refinement units_rep s Θ says that s finds the translation of what gds_lookup Θ finds;
  • decode_unit and the like decode fast data back into Core data, in types only; on canonical data (canon_unit: no local open, no name declared twice) decoding undoes the translation (decode_translate_unit).
Every lookup of Core.Syntactic.Members has a twin here over fast data with a lemma stating that, on a translation, it finds the translation of what the Core lookup finds (ft_entry_ok, fast_gc_entry_ok, …).

Balanced Maps

Maps keyed by member names, compared by String.compare (native once extracted, by the directive of Entrypoint).
Module SMap := FMapAVL.Make OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.
The plain trees of SMap, which a nested inductive can hold
Module SRaw := SMap.Raw.
Their lemmas
Module SP := SRaw.Proofs.

find after add, at a search tree.
Lemma sraw_find_add {A} (m : SRaw.tree A) x e y :
  SRaw.bst m -> SRaw.find y (SRaw.add x e m) = if String.eqb y x then Some e else SRaw.find y m.
Proof.
  intros Hb; rewrite SP.add_find by exact Hb.
  destruct (OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.compare y x) as [Hl | He | Hg]; cbn.
  - destruct (String.eqb_spec y x) as [-> |]; [ | reflexivity ].
    exfalso; exact (OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.lt_not_eq Hl eq_refl).
  - unfold OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.eq in He; subst; rewrite String.eqb_refl; reflexivity.
  - destruct (String.eqb_spec y x) as [-> |]; [ | reflexivity ].
    exfalso; exact (OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.lt_not_eq Hg eq_refl).
Qed.

The components of paths are compared by String.compare, which runs natively once extracted (the directive of Entrypoint); it is the order of OrdersEx.String_as_OT, whose lemmas the proofs use. OrdersEx.String_as_OT.compare itself is a definition of its own, which would extract to a walk over characters.
Lemma str_compare_eq : forall x y, String.compare x y = OrdersEx.String_as_OT.compare x y.
Proof. induction x as [| a x IH]; intros [| b y]; cbn; try reflexivity; rewrite IH; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma str_compare_spec : forall x y, CompSpec eq OrdersEx.String_as_OT.lt x y (String.compare x y).
Proof. intros; rewrite str_compare_eq; apply OrdersEx.String_as_OT.compare_spec. Qed.

Paths, compared lexicographically, component by component.
Lemma str_cmp_refl : forall x, String.compare x x = Eq.
Proof.
  intros x; destruct (str_compare_spec x x) as [_ | H | H];
    [ reflexivity | elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ H) | elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ H) ].
Qed.

SRaw.find, written directly: one String.compare per node, with no OrderedType.Compare built and matched.
Fixpoint string_tree_find {A} (x : string) (m : SRaw.tree A) : option A :=
  match m with
  | SRaw.Leaf _ => None
  | SRaw.Node l y d r _ =>
      match String.compare x y with
      | Eq => Some d
      | Lt => string_tree_find x l
      | Gt => string_tree_find x r
      end
  end.

It is SRaw.find.
Lemma string_tree_find_ok {A} x (m : SRaw.tree A) : string_tree_find x m = SRaw.find x m.
Proof.
  induction m as [| l IHl y d r IHr h]; [ reflexivity |]; cbn [string_tree_find SRaw.find].
  destruct (OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.compare x y) as [E | E | E].
  - apply OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.cmp_lt in E; change (String.compare x y = Lt) in E; rewrite E; exact IHl.
  - cbv [OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.eq] in E; subst; rewrite str_cmp_refl; reflexivity.
  - apply OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.cmp_lt in E; change (String.compare y x = Lt) in E.
    rewrite String.compare_antisym, E; exact IHr.
Qed.

The order of unit paths
Module PathOrd <: Orders.OrderedType.
  Definition t := list string.
  Definition eq := @Logic.eq t.
  #[global] Instance eq_equiv : Equivalence eq := _.

Lexicographic: the first component that differs decides, and a proper prefix comes first.
  Fixpoint compare (p q : t) : comparison :=
    match p, q with
    | [], [] => Eq
    | [], _ :: _ => Lt
    | _ :: _, [] => Gt
    | x :: p', y :: q' =>
        match String.compare x y with
        | Eq => compare p' q'
        | c => c
        end
    end.

p comes before q
  Definition lt (p q : t) : Prop := compare p q = Lt.

A path is equal to itself.
  Lemma compare_refl : forall p, compare p p = Eq.
  Proof. induction p as [| x p IH]; cbn; [ reflexivity | rewrite str_cmp_refl; exact IH ]. Qed.

Paths compared equal are equal.
  Lemma compare_eq : forall p q, compare p q = Eq -> p = q.
  Proof.
    induction p as [| x p IH]; intros [| y q]; cbn; try discriminate; [ reflexivity |].
    destruct (str_compare_spec x y) as [-> | _ | _]; try discriminate.
    intros H; f_equal; auto.
  Qed.

Swapping the paths swaps the result.
  Lemma compare_antisym : forall p q, compare q p = CompOpp (compare p q).
  Proof.
    induction p as [| x p IH]; intros [| y q]; cbn; try reflexivity.
    destruct (str_compare_spec x y) as [-> | H | H].
    - rewrite str_cmp_refl; apply IH.
    - destruct (str_compare_spec y x) as [-> | H' | H'];
        [ elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ H) | elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ (transitivity H H')) | reflexivity ].
    - destruct (str_compare_spec y x) as [-> | H' | H'];
        [ elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ H) | reflexivity | elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ (transitivity H H')) ].
  Qed.

The order is transitive.
  Lemma lt_trans : forall p q r, lt p q -> lt q r -> lt p r.
  Proof.
    unfold lt; induction p as [| x p IH]; intros [| y q] [| z r]; cbn; try discriminate; auto.
    destruct (str_compare_spec x y) as [-> | Hxy | Hxy]; try discriminate;
      destruct (str_compare_spec y z) as [-> | Hyz | Hyz]; try discriminate.
    - destruct (str_compare_spec z z) as [_ | H | H]; [ apply IH | elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ H) .. ].
    - destruct (str_compare_spec y z) as [-> | H | H];
        [ elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ Hyz) | reflexivity | elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ (transitivity H Hyz)) ].
    - destruct (str_compare_spec x z) as [-> | H | H];
        [ elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ Hxy) | reflexivity | elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ (transitivity H Hxy)) ].
    - destruct (str_compare_spec x z) as [-> | H | H]; [| reflexivity |].
      + elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ (transitivity Hxy Hyz)).
      + elim (StrictOrder_Irreflexive _ (transitivity (transitivity Hxy Hyz) H)).
  Qed.

  #[global] Instance lt_strorder : StrictOrder lt.
  Proof. split; [ intros p H; unfold lt in H; rewrite compare_refl in H; discriminate | exact lt_trans ]. Qed.

  #[global] Instance lt_compat : Proper (eq ==> eq ==> iff) lt.
  Proof. intros ? ? -> ? ? ->; reflexivity. Qed.

compare decides the order.
  Lemma compare_spec : forall p q, CompSpec eq lt p q (compare p q).
  Proof.
    intros p q; destruct (compare p q) eqn:E; constructor.
    - exact (compare_eq _ _ E).
    - exact E.
    - unfold lt; rewrite compare_antisym, E; reflexivity.
  Qed.

A path compared greater than another comes after it.
  Lemma compare_gt_lt : forall p q, compare p q = Gt -> lt q p.
  Proof. intros p q E; unfold lt; rewrite compare_antisym, E; reflexivity. Qed.

  Definition eq_dec : forall p q : t, {p = q} + {p <> q} := path_eq_dec.
End PathOrd.

The same order in the interface FMapAVL and FSetAVL take, written directly: its compare is one match on PathOrd.compare, no generic wrapper (as OrdersAlt.Backport_OT would add) in the comparisons of the maps.
Module PathOT <: OrderedType.OrderedType.
  Definition t := list string.
  Definition eq := @Logic.eq t.
  Definition lt := PathOrd.lt.
  Definition eq_refl : forall x : t, eq x x := @Logic.eq_refl t.
  Definition eq_sym : forall x y : t, eq x y -> eq y x := @Logic.eq_sym t.
  Definition eq_trans : forall x y z : t, eq x y -> eq y z -> eq x z := @Logic.eq_trans t.
  Definition lt_trans : forall x y z : t, lt x y -> lt y z -> lt x z := PathOrd.lt_trans.

A path does not come before itself.
  Lemma lt_not_eq : forall x y : t, lt x y -> ~ eq x y.
  Proof.
    intros x y H E; unfold eq in E; subst y; unfold lt, PathOrd.lt in H; rewrite PathOrd.compare_refl in H; discriminate.
  Qed.

PathOrd.compare, with its proof carried in the result
  Definition compare (x y : t) : OrderedType.Compare lt eq x y :=
    match PathOrd.compare x y as c return PathOrd.compare x y = c -> OrderedType.Compare lt eq x y with
    | Eq => fun E => OrderedType.EQ (PathOrd.compare_eq x y E)
    | Lt => fun E => OrderedType.LT E
    | Gt => fun E => OrderedType.GT (PathOrd.compare_gt_lt x y E)
    end Logic.eq_refl.

  Definition eq_dec : forall x y : t, {eq x y} + {~ eq x y} := path_eq_dec.
End PathOT.
Maps keyed by unit paths
Module PM := FMapAVL.Make PathOT.
Their facts
Module PMF := FMapFacts.WFacts_fun PathOT PM.

find after add in a map of paths.
Lemma pm_find_add : forall {A} (m : PM.t A) fp fq x,
    PM.find fq (PM.add fp x m) = if path_beq fq fp then Some x else PM.find fq m.
Proof.
  intros; rewrite PMF.add_o; destruct (PathOT.eq_dec fp fq) as [E | E]; unfold PathOT.eq, PathOrd.eq in E.
  - subst; rewrite path_beq_refl; reflexivity.
  - rewrite path_beq_false by congruence; reflexivity.
Qed.

PM.find, written directly over the tree: one PathOrd.compare per node, with no OrderedType.Compare built and matched.
Fixpoint path_tree_find {A} (x : path) (m : PM.Raw.tree A) : option A :=
  match m with
  | PM.Raw.Leaf _ => None
  | PM.Raw.Node l y d r _ =>
      match PathOrd.compare x y with
      | Eq => Some d
      | Lt => path_tree_find x l
      | Gt => path_tree_find x r
      end
  end.

It is PM.find.
Lemma path_tree_find_ok {A} x (m : PM.t A) : path_tree_find x (PM.this m) = PM.find x m.
Proof.
  unfold PM.find; generalize (PM.this m); clear m; intros m.
  induction m as [| l IHl y d r IHr h]; [ reflexivity |]; cbn [path_tree_find PM.Raw.find].
  destruct (PathOT.compare x y) as [E | E | E].
  - change (PathOrd.compare x y = Lt) in E; rewrite E; exact IHl.
  - cbv [PathOT.eq] in E; subst; rewrite PathOrd.compare_refl; reflexivity.
  - change (PathOrd.compare y x = Lt) in E; rewrite PathOrd.compare_antisym, E; exact IHr.
Qed.

The key a path is filed under: the path reversed, so that two keys differ early (paths share their first components, Prelude and the like, much more often than their last).
Definition path_key (fp : path) : path := List.rev' fp.

Keys are equal exactly when paths are.
Lemma path_key_beq : forall fp fq, path_beq (path_key fq) (path_key fp) = path_beq fq fp.
Proof.
  intros fp fq; unfold path_key, List.rev'; rewrite <- (List.rev_alt fq), <- (List.rev_alt fp).
  destruct (path_beq fq fp) eqn:E.
  - apply path_beq_true in E as ->; apply path_beq_refl.
  - apply path_beq_false; intros Hr; apply (f_equal (@List.rev _)) in Hr.
    rewrite (List.rev_involutive fq), (List.rev_involutive fp) in Hr; subst.
    rewrite path_beq_refl in E; discriminate.
Qed.

A map of paths keyed by path_key: what it finds at fp
Definition path_key_find {A} (fp : path) (m : PM.t A) : option A := path_tree_find (path_key fp) (PM.this m).

Adding x at fp
Definition path_key_add {A} (fp : path) (x : A) (m : PM.t A) : PM.t A := PM.add (path_key fp) x m.

path_key_find after path_key_add
Lemma path_key_find_add : forall {A} (m : PM.t A) fp fq x,
    path_key_find fq (path_key_add fp x m) = if path_beq fq fp then Some x else path_key_find fq m.
Proof.
  intros A m fp fq x; unfold path_key_find, path_key_add.
  rewrite (path_tree_find_ok _ (PM.add _ _ m)), (path_tree_find_ok _ m), pm_find_add, path_key_beq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Nothing is found in the empty map.
Lemma path_key_find_empty : forall {A} fp, path_key_find fp (PM.empty A) = None.
Proof. intros; unfold path_key_find; rewrite path_tree_find_ok; apply PMF.empty_o. Qed.

The Fast Module Layer


Inductive funit : Type :=
fu_mk Δ D: a unit with a closed body, as Core's gu_mk Δ (md_body sm_closed …): its parameters and its body
| fu_mk : list centry -> fmoddef -> funit
Core's unit kept as it is: an alias (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E)), which has no body to look into, or a unit with an open body (md_body sm_open), which no filed unit or open frame has
| fu_core : gunit -> funit
with fmoddef : Type :=
A closed body, as a trie
| fmd_body : ftrie -> fmoddef
with ftrie : Type :=
ft_mk m xs: the members by name (m), and the order index xs: the names declared, newest first. xs holds names only, never an entry.
| ft_mk : SRaw.tree fentry -> list string -> ftrie
with fentry : Type :=
Core's ge_def b pv κ A oM, and the value its body has in the empty environment, when it is stored: Some v for a transparent definition of an evaluated kind a command added, None from a translation (translate_entry); decoding forgets it (decode_entry)
| fe_def : bool -> bool -> abs_kind -> exp -> option exp -> option fdomain -> fentry
Core's ge_mod pv U, the unit fast
| fe_mod : bool -> funit -> fentry
Core's ge_ind pv pq k D Φ, the member's module a trie
| fe_ind : bool -> qname -> nat -> ind_decl -> ftrie -> fentry
Core's ge_def_mod pv A M U, the unit fast, and the value its term has in the empty environment, when it is stored, as for fe_def
| fe_def_mod : bool -> exp -> exp -> funit -> option fdomain -> fentry
Core's ge_record pv p R Φ, the record's module a trie
| fe_record : bool -> qname -> record_decl -> ftrie -> fentry.

The members of a trie by name
Definition ft_map (t : ftrie) : SRaw.tree fentry := match t with ft_mk m _ => m end.
The order index of a trie: its names, newest first
Definition ft_names (t : ftrie) : list string := match t with ft_mk _ xs => xs end.

The empty body
Definition ft_empty : ftrie := ft_mk (SRaw.Leaf _) nil.

One more member: one add and one cons of its name.
Definition ft_ext (t : ftrie) (x : string) (e : fentry) : ftrie :=
  match t with ft_mk m xs => ft_mk (SRaw.add x e m) (x :: xs) end.

The member named x: the newest one of that name.
Definition ft_find (t : ftrie) (x : string) : option fentry := string_tree_find x (ft_map t).

The body a path descends into through an entry, as gm_entry reads it: a submodule's body, an inductive type's or a record's module.
Definition fe_body (e : fentry) : option ftrie :=
  match e with
  | fe_mod _ (fu_mk _ (fmd_body t)) => Some t
  | fe_ind _ _ _ _ t => Some t
  | fe_record _ _ _ t => Some t
  | _ => None
  end.

The member at ip: one find per component, gm_entry's twin.
Fixpoint ft_entry (t : ftrie) (ip : list string) {struct ip} : option fentry :=
  match ip with
  | nil => None
  | x :: ip' =>
      match ft_find t x with
      | None => None
      | Some e =>
          match ip' with
          | nil => Some e
          | _ :: _ => match fe_body e with Some t' => ft_entry t' ip' | None => None end
          end
      end
  end.

The parameters of a unit, gu_params's twin
Definition fu_params (u : funit) : list centry :=
  match u with
  | fu_mk Δ _ => Δ
  | fu_core U => gu_params U
  end.

The body of a unit, the empty body for an alias, gu_mod's twin
Definition fu_body (u : funit) : ftrie :=
  match u with
  | fu_mk _ (fmd_body t) => t
  | fu_core _ => ft_empty
  end.

Whether an entry is private, ge_private's twin
Definition fe_private (e : fentry) : bool :=
  match e with
  | fe_def _ pv _ _ _ _ | fe_mod pv _ | fe_ind pv _ _ _ _ | fe_def_mod pv _ _ _ _ | fe_record pv _ _ _ => pv
  end.

Translation from Core

The entries are added oldest first, so that the newest entry of a name is the one the map keeps, as in gm_entry; a local open adds nothing, as gm_entry skips it (and a filed or open-frame body has none).
Fixpoint translate_unit (U : gunit) : funit :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk Δ (md_body sm_closed Φ) => fu_mk Δ (fmd_body (translate_mod Φ))
  | _ => fu_core U
  end
with translate_mod (Φ : gmod) : ftrie :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => ft_empty
  | gm_ext Φ' x E => ft_ext (translate_mod Φ') x (translate_entry E)
  | gm_open Φ' _ _ _ => translate_mod Φ'
  end
with translate_entry (E : gentry) : fentry :=
  match E with
  | ge_def b pv r A oM => fe_def b pv r A oM None
  | ge_mod pv U => fe_mod pv (translate_unit U)
  | ge_ind pv pq k D Φ => fe_ind pv pq k D (translate_mod Φ)
  | ge_def_mod pv A M U => fe_def_mod pv A M (translate_unit U) None
  | ge_record pv p R Φ => fe_record pv p R (translate_mod Φ)
  end.

Decoding to Core

For types and statements only, never run: how a specification names the Core data that fast data stands for. A trie's entries are decoded in place, then its body assembled along the order index.
The entries of a tree, decoded in place.
Fixpoint decode_tree_with (f : fentry -> gentry) (m : SRaw.tree fentry) : SRaw.tree gentry :=
  match m with
  | SRaw.Leaf _ => SRaw.Leaf _
  | SRaw.Node l k e r h => SRaw.Node (decode_tree_with f l) k (f e) (decode_tree_with f r) h
  end.

The body whose entries, newest first, are those of dm at the names xs.
Fixpoint assemble (dm : SRaw.tree gentry) (xs : list string) : gmod :=
  match xs with
  | nil => gm_nil
  | x :: xs' =>
      match SRaw.find x dm with
      | Some E => gm_ext (assemble dm xs') x E
      | None => assemble dm xs'
      end
  end.

The Core unit, body and entry fast data stand for
Fixpoint decode_unit (u : funit) : gunit :=
  match u with
  | fu_mk Δ (fmd_body t) => gu_mk Δ (md_body sm_closed (decode_mod t))
  | fu_core U => U
  end
with decode_mod (t : ftrie) : gmod :=
  match t with
  | ft_mk m xs =>
      assemble ((fix decode_tree (m : SRaw.tree fentry) : SRaw.tree gentry :=
                   match m with
                   | SRaw.Leaf _ => SRaw.Leaf _
                   | SRaw.Node l k e r h => SRaw.Node (decode_tree l) k (decode_entry e) (decode_tree r) h
                   end) m) xs
  end
with decode_entry (e : fentry) : gentry :=
  match e with
  | fe_def b pv r A oM _ => ge_def b pv r A oM
  | fe_mod pv u => ge_mod pv (decode_unit u)
  | fe_ind pv pq k D t => ge_ind pv pq k D (decode_mod t)
  | fe_def_mod pv A M u _ => ge_def_mod pv A M (decode_unit u)
  | fe_record pv p R t => ge_record pv p R (decode_mod t)
  end.

A body decodes by assembling its decoded tree.
Lemma decode_mod_unfold : forall m xs, decode_mod (ft_mk m xs) = assemble (decode_tree_with decode_entry m) xs.
Proof.
  intros m xs; cbn [decode_mod]; f_equal.
  induction m as [| l IHl k e r IHr h]; cbn; [ reflexivity | rewrite IHl, IHr; reflexivity ].
Qed.

Canonical Data

What a filed unit and an open frame are, by well-formedness (canon_of_wf): every body a path descends into is closed, with no local open and no name declared twice. On canonical data the fast lookups find what the Core ones find, translated, and decoding undoes the translation.
Fixpoint canon_unit (U : gunit) : Prop :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk _ (md_body sm_closed Φ) => canon_mod Φ
  | gu_mk _ (md_body sm_open _) => False
  | gu_mk _ (md_alias _) => True
  end
with canon_mod (Φ : gmod) : Prop :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => True
  | gm_ext Φ' x E => ~ In x (gm_names Φ') /\ canon_mod Φ' /\ canon_entry E
  | gm_open _ _ _ _ => False
  end
with canon_entry (E : gentry) : Prop :=
  match E with
  | ge_def _ _ _ _ _ => True
  | ge_mod _ U => canon_unit U
  | ge_ind _ _ _ _ Φ => canon_mod Φ
  | ge_def_mod _ _ _ U => canon_unit U
  | ge_record _ _ _ Φ => canon_mod Φ
  end.

Member Lookup Is gm_entry's

A translated body is a search tree.
Lemma translate_mod_bst : forall Φ, SRaw.bst (ft_map (translate_mod Φ)).
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH x E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; cbn [translate_mod].
  - constructor.
  - destruct (translate_mod Φ) as [m xs] eqn:Et; cbn in *; apply SP.add_bst; exact IH.
  - exact IH.
Qed.

The newest entry of a name in a body.
Fixpoint gm_newest (Φ : gmod) (x : string) : option gentry :=
  match Φ with
  | gm_nil => None
  | gm_ext Φ' y E => if String.eqb x y then Some E else gm_newest Φ' x
  | gm_open Φ' _ _ _ => gm_newest Φ' x
  end.

A name finds the translation of its newest entry.
Lemma translate_mod_find : forall Φ x, ft_find (translate_mod Φ) x = option_map translate_entry (gm_newest Φ x).
Proof.
  intros Φ x; unfold ft_find; rewrite string_tree_find_ok; revert x.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros x; cbn [translate_mod gm_newest].
  - reflexivity.
  - pose proof (translate_mod_bst Φ) as Hb.
    destruct (translate_mod Φ) as [m xs] eqn:Et; cbn [ft_ext ft_map] in *.
    rewrite sraw_find_add by exact Hb; destruct (String.eqb x y); [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
  - apply IH.
Qed.

The body a path descends into through a Core entry, as gm_entry reads it.
Definition entry_body (E : gentry) : option gmod :=
  match E with
  | ge_mod _ (gu_mk _ (md_body _ Φ)) => Some Φ
  | ge_ind _ _ _ _ Φ => Some Φ
  | ge_record _ _ _ Φ => Some Φ
  | _ => None
  end.

The body a canonical entry leads into, translated
Lemma fe_body_translate : forall E, canon_entry E -> fe_body (translate_entry E) = option_map translate_mod (entry_body E).
Proof. intros [| ? [? [[|] ?|] ] | | |] Hc; cbn in Hc; first [ contradiction | reflexivity ]. Qed.

The newest entry of a name in a canonical body is canonical.
Lemma canon_newest : forall Φ x E, canon_mod Φ -> gm_newest Φ x = Some E -> canon_entry E.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E' | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros x E Hc Hn; cbn in *; [ discriminate | | contradiction ].
  destruct Hc as (_ & HΦ & HE); destruct (String.eqb x y); [ injection Hn as <-; exact HE | eauto ].
Qed.

The body a canonical entry leads into is canonical.
Lemma canon_entry_body : forall E Φ, canon_entry E -> entry_body E = Some Φ -> canon_mod Φ.
Proof.
  intros [| ? [? [[|] ?|] ] | | |] Φ Hc He; cbn in *; try discriminate; try contradiction; injection He as <-; exact Hc.
Qed.

gm_entry reads the newest entry of the first name.
Lemma gm_entry_newest : forall Φ x ip,
    gm_entry Φ (x :: ip) =
      match gm_newest Φ x with
      | None => None
      | Some E => match ip with
                  | nil => Some E
                  | _ :: _ => match entry_body E with Some Φ' => gm_entry Φ' ip | None => None end
                  end
      end.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros x ip; cbn [gm_entry gm_newest].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (String.eqb x y); [| apply IH ].
    destruct ip; [ reflexivity |].
    destruct E as [| ? [? [] ] | | |]; reflexivity.
  - apply IH.
Qed.

The trie finds the translation of what gm_entry finds.
Theorem ft_entry_ok : forall ip Φ, canon_mod Φ -> ft_entry (translate_mod Φ) ip = option_map translate_entry (gm_entry Φ ip).
Proof.
  induction ip as [| x ip IH]; intros Φ Hc; [ rewrite gm_entry_nil; reflexivity |].
  cbn [ft_entry]; rewrite translate_mod_find, gm_entry_newest.
  destruct (gm_newest Φ x) as [E |] eqn:En; cbn [option_map]; [| reflexivity ].
  pose proof (canon_newest _ _ _ Hc En) as HE.
  destruct ip as [| z ip']; [ reflexivity |].
  rewrite fe_body_translate by exact HE; destruct (entry_body E) eqn:Eb; cbn [option_map]; [| reflexivity ].
  apply IH, (canon_entry_body _ _ HE Eb).
Qed.

A translated unit's parameters
Lemma translate_unit_params : forall U, fu_params (translate_unit U) = gu_params U.
Proof. intros [Δ [[|] Φ | H]]; reflexivity. Qed.

A canonical translated unit's body
Lemma translate_unit_body : forall U, canon_unit U -> fu_body (translate_unit U) = translate_mod (gu_mod U).
Proof. intros [Δ [[|] Φ | H]] Hc; cbn in Hc; first [ contradiction | reflexivity ]. Qed.

Lemma find_decode_tree : forall m x, SRaw.find x (decode_tree_with decode_entry m) = option_map decode_entry (SRaw.find x m).
Proof.
  induction m as [| l IHl k e r IHr h]; intros x; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.compare x k); auto.
Qed.

Assembling along names other than x ignores an add at x.
Lemma assemble_add : forall xs m x e, SRaw.bst m -> ~ In x xs ->
    assemble (decode_tree_with decode_entry (SRaw.add x e m)) xs = assemble (decode_tree_with decode_entry m) xs.
Proof.
  induction xs as [| y xs IH]; intros m x e Hb Hn; cbn [assemble]; [ reflexivity |].
  rewrite !find_decode_tree, sraw_find_add by exact Hb.
  destruct (String.eqb_spec y x) as [-> | _]; [ elim Hn; left; reflexivity |].
  rewrite IH by (auto || (intros Hi; apply Hn; right; exact Hi)); reflexivity.
Qed.

Decoding one more member: one more gm_ext.
Lemma decode_ext : forall t x e, SRaw.bst (ft_map t) -> ~ In x (ft_names t) ->
    decode_mod (ft_ext t x e) = gm_ext (decode_mod t) x (decode_entry e).
Proof.
  intros [m xs] x e Hb Hn; cbn [ft_ext ft_map ft_names] in *.
  rewrite !decode_mod_unfold; cbn [assemble].
  rewrite find_decode_tree, sraw_find_add, String.eqb_refl by exact Hb; cbn [option_map].
  rewrite assemble_add by assumption; reflexivity.
Qed.

The order index of a canonical body is its names.
Lemma translate_mod_names : forall Φ, canon_mod Φ -> ft_names (translate_mod Φ) = gm_names Φ.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros Hc; cbn in *; [ reflexivity | | contradiction ].
  destruct Hc as (_ & Hc & _); destruct (translate_mod Φ) as [m xs] eqn:Et; cbn in *; rewrite <- IH by exact Hc; reflexivity.
Qed.

Decoding undoes the translation of canonical data.
Fixpoint decode_translate_unit (U : gunit) {struct U} : canon_unit U -> decode_unit (translate_unit U) = U
with decode_translate_mod (Φ : gmod) {struct Φ} : canon_mod Φ -> decode_mod (translate_mod Φ) = Φ
with decode_translate_entry (E : gentry) {struct E} : canon_entry E -> decode_entry (translate_entry E) = E.
Proof.
  - destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ | H]]; cbn; intros Hc; [ contradiction | rewrite (decode_translate_mod Φ Hc) |]; reflexivity.
  - destruct Φ as [| Φ x E | Φ H its]; cbn [translate_mod canon_mod]; intros Hc; [ reflexivity | | contradiction ].
    destruct Hc as (Hn & HcΦ & HcE).
    rewrite decode_ext by (apply translate_mod_bst || (rewrite translate_mod_names by exact HcΦ; exact Hn)).
    rewrite (decode_translate_mod Φ HcΦ), (decode_translate_entry E HcE); reflexivity.
  - destruct E as [b pv r A oM | pv U | pv pq k D Φ | pv A M U | pv p R Φ]; cbn; intros Hc.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite (decode_translate_unit U Hc); reflexivity.
    + rewrite (decode_translate_mod Φ Hc); reflexivity.
    + rewrite (decode_translate_unit U Hc); reflexivity.
    + rewrite (decode_translate_mod Φ Hc); reflexivity.
Qed.

The Filed Units

One balanced map from the whole path of a unit to the unit, and the filing order (paths only, newest first), which decoding reads. Filing a unit is one PM.add and one cons. Next to them, the units the unit being run sees, in a map of their own (fus_visible): it grows by one add per path that becomes imported (fus_see), is set aside while an imported unit runs (fus_with_visible), and is never rebuilt, so that a lookup is one search. Both maps are keyed by path_key.
Record funits : Type := mk_funits
  {
each filed unit, by its whole path
    fus_map : PM.t funit
    
the paths, in filing order, newest first
  ; fus_order : list path
    
the filed units the unit being run imported, by their whole paths (visible_rep)
  ; fus_visible : PM.t funit }.

Nothing filed
Definition funits_empty : funits := mk_funits (PM.empty _) nil (PM.empty _).

Filing the unit u at fp; the units seen are not changed.
Definition fus_file (fp : path) (u : funit) (s : funits) : funits :=
  mk_funits (path_key_add fp u (fus_map s)) (fp :: fus_order s) (fus_visible s).

The unit filed at fp
Definition fus_find (s : funits) (fp : path) : option funit := path_key_find fp (fus_map s).

The Core units s stands for, for types only.
Definition decode_units (s : funits) : gdeps :=
  flat_map (fun fp => match fus_find s fp with Some u => [(fp, decode_unit u)] | None => nil end) (fus_order s).

Canonical filed units: no path filed twice, every unit canonical.
Fixpoint canon_deps (Θ : gdeps) : Prop :=
  match Θ with
  | nil => True
  | (fp, U) :: Θ' => gds_lookup Θ' fp = None /\ canon_unit U /\ canon_deps Θ'
  end.

s refines Θ.
Record units_rep (s : funits) (Θ : gdeps) : Prop := mk_units_rep
  {
a path finds the translation of what gds_lookup finds
    ur_find : forall fp, fus_find s fp = option_map translate_unit (gds_lookup Θ fp)
    
the order index lists exactly Θ's paths
  ; ur_order : fus_order s = map fst Θ }.

Nothing filed refines nothing filed.
Lemma units_rep_empty : units_rep funits_empty nil.
Proof. constructor; [ intros; apply path_key_find_empty | reflexivity ]. Qed.

Filing one unit keeps the refinement.
Theorem units_rep_file : forall s Θ fp U,
    units_rep s Θ -> units_rep (fus_file fp (translate_unit U) s) ((fp, U) :: Θ).
Proof.
  intros s Θ fp U [Hf Ho]; unfold fus_file; constructor; cbn [fus_order map fst]; [| rewrite Ho; reflexivity ].
  intros fq; unfold fus_find; cbn [fus_map gds_lookup]; rewrite path_key_find_add.
  destruct (path_beq fq fp); [ reflexivity | apply Hf ].
Qed.

A unit of canonical filed units is canonical.
Lemma canon_deps_lookup : forall Θ fp U, canon_deps Θ -> gds_lookup Θ fp = Some U -> canon_unit U.
Proof.
  induction Θ as [| [fq V] Θ IH]; intros fp U Hc Hl; cbn in *; [ discriminate |].
  destruct Hc as (_ & HV & Hc); destruct (path_beq fp fq); [ injection Hl as <-; exact HV | eauto ].
Qed.

Decoding gives a canonical Θ back.
Theorem decode_units_ok : forall Θ s, canon_deps Θ -> units_rep s Θ -> decode_units s = Θ.
Proof.
  intros Θ s Hc [Hf Ho]; unfold decode_units; rewrite Ho.
  assert (Hgen : forall Θ0, canon_deps Θ0 ->
    (forall fp, In fp (map fst Θ0) -> fus_find s fp = option_map translate_unit (gds_lookup Θ0 fp)) ->
    flat_map (fun fp => match fus_find s fp with Some u => [(fp, decode_unit u)] | None => nil end) (map fst Θ0) = Θ0).
  { induction Θ0 as [| [fp U] Θ0 IH]; intros HC HF; [ reflexivity |].
    destruct HC as (Hn & HU & HC); cbn [map fst flat_map].
    pose proof (HF fp (or_introl eq_refl)) as E; cbn [gds_lookup] in E.
    rewrite path_beq_refl in E; rewrite E; cbn [option_map app]; rewrite decode_translate_unit by exact HU.
    f_equal; apply IH; [ exact HC |]; intros fq Hq; rewrite (HF fq (or_intror Hq)); cbn [gds_lookup].
    destruct (path_beq fq fp) eqn:Eb; [| reflexivity ].
    apply path_beq_true in Eb as ->.
    exfalso; clear -Hn Hq; induction Θ0 as [| [fr V] Θ0 IH]; cbn in *; [ contradiction |].
    destruct (path_beq fp fr) eqn:Eb; [ discriminate |].
    destruct Hq as [-> | Hq]; [ rewrite path_beq_refl in Eb; discriminate | exact (IH Hn Hq) ]. }
  apply Hgen; [ exact Hc |]; intros; apply Hf.
Qed.

The decoded units find the decoding of what the map finds, for any Θ the map refines.
Lemma decode_units_lookup : forall s Θ, units_rep s Θ -> forall fp, gds_lookup (decode_units s) fp = option_map decode_unit (fus_find s fp).
Proof.
  intros s Θ [Hf Ho] fp; unfold decode_units; rewrite Ho.
  assert (Hgen : forall L, (forall q, In q L -> fus_find s q <> None) ->
    gds_lookup (flat_map (fun fp => match fus_find s fp with Some u => [(fp, decode_unit u)] | None => nil end) L) fp =
    if existsb (path_beq fp) L then option_map decode_unit (fus_find s fp) else None).
  { induction L as [| q L IH]; intros HL; [ reflexivity |]; cbn [flat_map existsb].
    destruct (fus_find s q) as [u |] eqn:Eq; [| exfalso; exact (HL q (or_introl eq_refl) Eq) ].
    cbn [app gds_lookup]; destruct (path_beq fp q) eqn:Eb; cbn [orb].
    - apply path_beq_true in Eb as ->; rewrite Eq; reflexivity.
    - apply IH; intros; apply HL; right; assumption. }
  rewrite Hgen.
  - destruct (existsb (path_beq fp) (map fst Θ)) eqn:Ex; [ reflexivity |].
    rewrite Hf.
    destruct (gds_lookup Θ fp) eqn:El; [| reflexivity ].
    exfalso; apply gds_lookup_in in El; apply (in_map fst) in El; cbn in El.
    apply existsb_path_beq in El; congruence.
  - intros q Hq; rewrite Hf; apply in_map_iff in Hq as ([q' U] & <- & Hin); cbn [fst].
    destruct (gds_lookup Θ q') eqn:El; [ discriminate |].
    apply gds_dom_none in El; elim El; unfold gds_dom; apply (in_map fst) in Hin; exact Hin.
Qed.

What a Unit Sees

The unit being run sees what it imported: the units of fus_visible, which are the filed units at the paths it imported (visible_rep). The map grows by one add per path that becomes imported (fus_see); it is set aside, not rebuilt, while an imported unit runs (fus_with_visible). The restriction itself is never built.
The units seen at s are exactly those filed at the paths of D. The invariants state it of the units with their stored values dropped (visible_rep); the lookups read it of those (visible_rep_drop).
Definition visible_rep_exact (s : funits) (D : list path) : Prop :=
  forall fp, path_key_find fp (fus_visible s) = if existsb (path_beq fp) D then fus_find s fp else None.

s with the units seen m
Definition fus_with_visible (s : funits) (m : PM.t funit) : funits := mk_funits (fus_map s) (fus_order s) m.

The paths L seen as well: one add each, of the unit filed there
Definition fus_see (L : list path) (s : funits) : funits :=
  fus_with_visible s (fold_left (fun m fp => match fus_find s fp with Some u => path_key_add fp u m | None => m end) L (fus_visible s)).

Changing the units seen changes no unit filed.
Lemma units_rep_with_visible : forall s m Θ, units_rep s Θ -> units_rep (fus_with_visible s m) Θ.
Proof. intros s m Θ [Hf Ho]; constructor; [ exact Hf | exact Ho ]. Qed.

Lemma units_rep_see : forall L s Θ, units_rep s Θ -> units_rep (fus_see L s) Θ.
Proof. intros; apply units_rep_with_visible; assumption. Qed.

What a unit sees: the units, and the paths it imported
Record fview : Type := mk_fview
  {
every unit filed so far, with the units seen
    fv_units : funits
    
the paths the unit being run imported
  ; fv_dom : list path }.

The unit at fp, if it is imported: one search
Definition fv_find (v : fview) (fp : path) : option funit := path_key_find fp (fus_visible (fv_units v)).

The Core units a view stands for, for types only: the restriction of the decoded units to the imported paths.
Definition view_deps (v : fview) : gdeps := gds_restrict (fv_dom v) (decode_units (fv_units v)).

The view finds the translation of what the restriction finds.
Theorem fv_find_ok : forall v Θ fp, units_rep (fv_units v) Θ -> visible_rep_exact (fv_units v) (fv_dom v) ->
    fv_find v fp = option_map translate_unit (gds_lookup (gds_restrict (fv_dom v) Θ) fp).
Proof.
  intros [s D] Θ fp H Hv; unfold fv_find; cbn [fv_dom fv_units] in *; rewrite gds_lookup_restrict, Hv.
  destruct (existsb _ _); [ apply (ur_find _ _ H) | reflexivity ].
Qed.

Open Frames

A frame as Core's (qname * frame_kind * gunit), its body a trie.
Record fframe : Type := mk_fframe
  {
the frame's own module path
    ff_path : qname
    
what the frame is the module of
  ; ff_kind : frame_kind
    
its own parameters
  ; ff_params : ctx
    
its members so far
  ; ff_body : ftrie }.

The open frames, innermost first
Definition fstack : Type := list fframe.

The fast frame of a Core one
Definition translate_frame (f : (qname * frame_kind * gunit)%type) : fframe :=
  let '(mp, K, U) := f in mk_fframe mp K (gu_params U) (translate_mod (gu_mod U)).

The fast frames of a Core stack
Definition fs_of (Ξ : gstack) : fstack := map translate_frame Ξ.

The Core frame a fast one stands for, for types only
Definition decode_frame (f : fframe) : (qname * frame_kind * gunit)%type :=
  (ff_path f, ff_kind f, gu_body (ff_params f) (decode_mod (ff_body f))).

The Core stack a fast one stands for, for types only
Definition decode_stack (fs : fstack) : gstack := map decode_frame fs.

A frame of a well-formed stack: a closed body.
Definition frame_closed (U : gunit) : Prop :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk _ (md_body sm_closed _) => True
  | _ => False
  end.

A canonical frame: a closed canonical body.
Definition canon_frame (U : gunit) : Prop :=
  match U with
  | gu_mk _ (md_body sm_closed Φ) => canon_mod Φ
  | _ => False
  end.

Every frame closed
Definition stack_closed (Ξ : gstack) : Prop := Forall (fun f => frame_closed (snd f)) Ξ.

Every frame canonical
Definition canon_stack (Ξ : gstack) : Prop := Forall (fun f => canon_frame (snd f)) Ξ.

A canonical stack's frames are closed bodies.
Lemma canon_stack_closed : forall Ξ, canon_stack Ξ -> stack_closed Ξ.
Proof.
  intros Ξ H; induction H as [| f Ξ Hf _ IH]; constructor; [| exact IH ].
  destruct f as [[mp K] [Δ [[|] Φ | E]]]; cbn in *; tauto.
Qed.

Decoding the fast frames of a canonical stack gives it back.
Theorem decode_stack_ok : forall Ξ, canon_stack Ξ -> decode_stack (fs_of Ξ) = Ξ.
Proof.
  unfold decode_stack, fs_of; intros Ξ H; induction H as [| f Ξ Hf _ IH]; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct f as [[mp K] [Δ [[|] Φ | E]]]; cbn in Hf; try contradiction.
  change (decode_frame (translate_frame (mp, K, gu_body Δ Φ)) :: map decode_frame (map translate_frame Ξ) = (mp, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ).
  rewrite IH; unfold decode_frame, translate_frame; cbn [ff_path ff_kind ff_params ff_body gu_params gu_mod].
  rewrite decode_translate_mod by exact Hf; reflexivity.
Qed.

The parameters of all the frames, gs_tele's twin
Fixpoint fs_tele (fs : fstack) : ctx :=
  match fs with
  | nil => nil
  | f :: fs' => ff_params f ++ fs_tele fs'
  end.

The telescope of the fast frames of a stack is its telescope.
Lemma fs_tele_of : forall Ξ, fs_tele (fs_of Ξ) = gs_tele Ξ.
Proof. unfold fs_of; induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; cbn; [ reflexivity | rewrite IH; reflexivity ]. Qed.

The telescope of a decoded stack is that of the fast frames.
Lemma fs_tele_dec : forall fs, gs_tele (decode_stack fs) = fs_tele fs.
Proof. unfold decode_stack; induction fs as [| f fs IH]; cbn; [ reflexivity | rewrite IH; reflexivity ]. Qed.

The innermost frame's path, gs_path's twin
Definition fs_path (fs : fstack) : qname :=
  match fs with
  | f :: _ => ff_path f
  | nil => q_abs nil nil
  end.

The path of the innermost frame of a decoded stack
Lemma fs_path_dec : forall fs, gs_path (decode_stack fs) = fs_path fs.
Proof. intros [| f fs]; reflexivity. Qed.

One member more in the innermost frame, gs_add's twin: one ft_ext.
Definition fs_add (x : string) (e : fentry) (fs : fstack) : fstack :=
  match fs with
  | f :: fs' => mk_fframe (ff_path f) (ff_kind f) (ff_params f) (ft_ext (ff_body f) x e) :: fs'
  | nil => nil
  end.

Adding a translated entry fast is adding it in Core.
Lemma fs_add_of : forall x E Ξ, fs_add x (translate_entry E) (fs_of Ξ) = fs_of (gs_add x E Ξ).
Proof. intros x E [| [[mp K] U] Ξ]; reflexivity. Qed.

A frame pushed, gs_push's twin
Definition fs_push (mp : qname) (Δ : ctx) (fs : fstack) : fstack := mk_fframe mp fk_module Δ ft_empty :: fs.

The frame of the module of a member of a group, gs_push_ind's twin
Definition fs_push_ind (mp pq : qname) (k : nat) (D : ind_decl) (Δ : ctx) (fs : fstack) : fstack :=
  mk_fframe mp (fk_ind pq k D) Δ ft_empty :: fs.

The frame of the module of a record type, gs_push_record's twin
Definition fs_push_record (mp : qname) (R : record_decl) (Δ : ctx) (fs : fstack) : fstack :=
  mk_fframe mp (fk_record R) (ce_ass (sort_exp_kind (record_sort R)) (record_self mp R) :: Δ) ft_empty :: fs.

Whether x is fresh in the innermost frame, gs_fresh's twin
Definition fs_fresh_dec (x : string) (fs : fstack) : bool :=
  match fs with
  | f :: _ => match ft_find (ff_body f) x with None => true | Some _ => false end
  | nil => false
  end.

A canonical body has a newest entry of a name exactly when it declares the name.
Lemma gm_newest_names : forall Φ x, canon_mod Φ -> (gm_newest Φ x = None <-> ~ In x (gm_names Φ)).
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros x Hc; cbn in *; [ tauto | | contradiction ].
  destruct Hc as (_ & Hc & _); destruct (String.eqb_spec x y) as [-> | Hne].
  - split; [ discriminate | intros Hn; elim Hn; left; reflexivity ].
  - rewrite (IH x Hc); split; [ intros Hn [-> | Hin]; [ exact (Hne eq_refl) | exact (Hn Hin) ] | intros Hn Hin; exact (Hn (or_intror Hin)) ].
Qed.

Freshness decided fast, on a canonical stack
Lemma fs_fresh_dec_of : forall x Ξ, canon_stack Ξ -> (fs_fresh_dec x (fs_of Ξ) = true <-> gs_fresh x Ξ).
Proof.
  intros x [| [[mp K] U] Ξ] Hc; cbn; [ split; [ discriminate | contradiction ] |].
  inversion Hc as [| ? ? HU _]; subst; cbn in HU.
  destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ | E]]; try contradiction; cbn [gu_mod].
  rewrite translate_mod_find; unfold gm_fresh; rewrite <- (gm_newest_names Φ x HU).
  destruct (gm_newest Φ x); cbn [option_map]; split; congruence.
Qed.

The Lookups

Each Core lookup of a global path, over a function uf giving the filed units fast and over the fast frames. On the translation of a Core context it finds what the Core lookup finds, translated (fast_gc_entry_ok and the like).
A located body: its full telescope and its members, fast
Definition translate_loc (r : (ctx * gmod)%type) : (ctx * ftrie)%type := (fst r, translate_mod (snd r)).

The innermost frame p is in, with p read inside it, and the parameters of the frames outside it; gs_find_tele's twin.
Fixpoint fs_find_tele (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option (fframe * list string * ctx) :=
  match fs with
  | nil => None
  | f :: fs' =>
      match qname_strip (ff_path f) p with
      | Some ip => Some (f, ip, fs_tele fs')
      | None => fs_find_tele fs' p
      end
  end.

What a lookup reads of the frame found: its parameters and its body
Definition ff_view (r : (fframe * list string * ctx)%type) : (ctx * ftrie * list string * ctx)%type :=
  let '(f, ip, T) := r in (ff_params f, ff_body f, ip, T).

The same of a Core frame, translated
Definition translate_frame_view (r : (gunit * list string * ctx)%type) : (ctx * ftrie * list string * ctx)%type :=
  let '(U, ip, T) := r in (gu_params U, translate_mod (gu_mod U), ip, T).

The frame found fast reads as the Core frame found.
Lemma fs_find_tele_of : forall Ξ p,
    option_map ff_view (fs_find_tele (fs_of Ξ) p) = option_map translate_frame_view (gs_find_tele Ξ p).
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros p; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p); [ cbn; rewrite fs_tele_of; reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

The kind of the frame found, alike
Lemma fs_find_tele_kind : forall Ξ p f ip T,
    fs_find_tele (fs_of Ξ) p = Some (f, ip, T) ->
    exists mp U T', gs_find_tele Ξ p = Some (U, ip, T') /\ f = translate_frame (mp, ff_kind f, U).
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros * H; cbn in *; [ discriminate |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p); [ injection H as <- <- <-; do 3 eexists; split; reflexivity | exact (IH _ _ _ _ H) ].
Qed.

The innermost frame p is in, gs_find's twin, with the frame.
Fixpoint fs_find (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option (fframe * list string) :=
  match fs with
  | nil => None
  | f :: fs' =>
      match qname_strip (ff_path f) p with
      | Some ip => Some (f, ip)
      | None => fs_find fs' p
      end
  end.

The member of a group whose module is the open frame at p, gs_find_ind's twin
Fixpoint fs_find_ind (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option (qname * nat * ind_decl) :=
  match fs with
  | nil => None
  | f :: fs' =>
      match qname_strip (ff_path f) p with
      | Some nil =>
          match ff_kind f with
          | fk_ind pq k D => Some (pq, k, D)
          | fk_module | fk_record _ => None
          end
      | Some (_ :: _) => None
      | None => fs_find_ind fs' p
      end
  end.

The record type whose module is the open frame at p, gs_find_record's twin
Fixpoint fs_find_record (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option record_decl :=
  match fs with
  | nil => None
  | f :: fs' =>
      match qname_strip (ff_path f) p with
      | Some nil =>
          match ff_kind f with
          | fk_record R => Some R
          | fk_module | fk_ind _ _ _ => None
          end
      | Some (_ :: _) => None
      | None => fs_find_record fs' p
      end
  end.

The body of the frame found and the path in it
Definition ff_find_view (r : (fframe * list string)%type) : (ftrie * list string)%type := (ff_body (fst r), snd r).

Alike for gs_find
Lemma fs_find_of : forall Ξ p,
    option_map ff_find_view (fs_find (fs_of Ξ) p) = option_map (fun r => (translate_mod (gu_mod (fst r)), snd r)) (gs_find Ξ p).
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros p; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p); [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

The member of the frame found fast is the Core one.
Lemma fs_find_ind_of : forall Ξ p, fs_find_ind (fs_of Ξ) p = gs_find_ind Ξ p.
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros p; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p) as [[|] |]; [ reflexivity | reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

The record of the frame found fast is the Core one.
Lemma fs_find_record_of : forall Ξ p, fs_find_record (fs_of Ξ) p = gs_find_record Ξ p.
Proof.
  induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros p; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p) as [[|] |]; [ reflexivity | reflexivity | apply IH ].
Qed.

Through a Body

gm_resolve's twin: a definition only, read through body modules
Fixpoint ft_resolve (t : ftrie) (ip : list string) {struct ip} : option gentry :=
  match ip with
  | nil => None
  | x :: ip' =>
      match ft_find t x with
      | None => None
      | Some e =>
          match ip', e with
          | nil, fe_def b pv r A oM _ => Some (ge_def b pv r A oM)
          | _ :: _, _ => match fe_body e with Some t' => ft_resolve t' ip' | None => None end
          | nil, _ => None
          end
      end
  end.

What the submodule ip is, through the entry e of a body of telescope T: gm_submodule's step
Fixpoint fe_submodule (T : ctx) (e : fentry) (ip : list string) {struct ip} : option modres :=
  match e with
  | fe_mod _ (fu_mk Δ (fmd_body t')) =>
      match ip with
      | nil => Some (mr_body (Δ ++ T) None)
      | z :: ip' => match ft_find t' z with Some e' => fe_submodule (Δ ++ T) e' ip' | None => None end
      end
  | fe_mod _ (fu_core (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E'))) =>
      match ip with
      | nil => Some (mr_alias (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E')))
      | _ :: _ => None
      end
  | fe_ind _ pq k D t' =>
      match ip with
      | nil => Some (mr_body (ind_uparams D) (Some (pq, k, D)))
      | z :: ip' => match ft_find t' z with Some e' => fe_submodule (ind_uparams D) e' ip' | None => None end
      end
  | fe_def_mod _ _ _ (fu_core (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E'))) _ =>
      match ip with
      | nil => Some (mr_alias (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E')))
      | _ :: _ => None
      end
  | fe_record _ p R t' =>
      match ip with
      | nil => Some (mr_body (record_mod_tele p R) None)
      | z :: ip' => match ft_find t' z with Some e' => fe_submodule (record_mod_tele p R) e' ip' | None => None end
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

gm_submodule's twin
Definition ft_submodule (T : ctx) (t : ftrie) (x : string) (ip : list string) : option modres :=
  match ft_find t x with
  | Some e => fe_submodule T e ip
  | None => None
  end.

gm_submodule reads the newest entry of the name.
Lemma gm_submodule_newest : forall Φ T x ip,
    gm_submodule T Φ x ip =
      match gm_newest Φ x with
      | Some E =>
          match E with
          | ge_mod _ (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ')) =>
              match ip with
              | nil => Some (mr_body (Δ ++ T) None)
              | z :: ip' => gm_submodule (Δ ++ T) Φ' z ip'
              end
          | ge_mod _ (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E')) =>
              match ip with
              | nil => Some (mr_alias (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E')))
              | _ :: _ => None
              end
          | ge_ind _ pq k D Φ' =>
              match ip with
              | nil => Some (mr_body (ind_uparams D) (Some (pq, k, D)))
              | z :: ip' => gm_submodule (ind_uparams D) Φ' z ip'
              end
          | ge_def_mod _ _ _ (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E')) =>
              match ip with
              | nil => Some (mr_alias (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E')))
              | _ :: _ => None
              end
          | ge_def_mod _ _ _ (gu_mk _ (md_body _ _)) => None
          | ge_record _ p R Φ' =>
              match ip with
              | nil => Some (mr_body (record_mod_tele p R) None)
              | z :: ip' => gm_submodule (record_mod_tele p R) Φ' z ip'
              end
          | ge_def _ _ _ _ _ => None
          end
      | None => None
      end.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros T x ip; cbn [gm_submodule gm_newest].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (String.eqb x y); [ reflexivity | apply IH ].
  - apply IH.
Qed.

The trie finds the submodule gm_submodule finds.
Theorem ft_submodule_ok : forall ip Φ T x, canon_mod Φ -> ft_submodule T (translate_mod Φ) x ip = gm_submodule T Φ x ip.
Proof.
  induction ip as [| z ip IH]; intros Φ T x Hc; unfold ft_submodule; rewrite translate_mod_find, gm_submodule_newest;
    destruct (gm_newest Φ x) as [E |] eqn:En; cbn [option_map]; try reflexivity;
    pose proof (canon_newest _ _ _ Hc En) as HE;
    destruct E as [b pv r A oM | pv [Δ [[|] Φ' | E']] | pv pq k D Φ' | pv A M [Δ [[|] Φ' | E']] | pv p R Φ'];
    cbn in HE; try contradiction; try reflexivity;
    cbn [translate_entry translate_unit fe_submodule]; rewrite <- IH by exact HE; reflexivity.
Qed.

gm_module's twin
Definition ft_module (T : ctx) (oD : option indref) (t : ftrie) (ip : list string) : option modres :=
  match ip with
  | nil => Some (mr_body T oD)
  | x :: ip' => ft_submodule T t x ip'
  end.

The trie finds the module gm_module finds.
Lemma ft_module_ok : forall T oD Φ ip, canon_mod Φ -> ft_module T oD (translate_mod Φ) ip = gm_module T oD Φ ip.
Proof. intros T oD Φ [| x ip] Hc; [ reflexivity | apply ft_submodule_ok, Hc ]. Qed.

The body module ip through the entry e, gm_subbody's step
Fixpoint fe_subbody (T : ctx) (e : fentry) (ip : list string) {struct ip} : option (ctx * ftrie) :=
  match e with
  | fe_mod _ (fu_mk Δ (fmd_body t')) =>
      match ip with
      | nil => Some (Δ ++ T, t')
      | z :: ip' => match ft_find t' z with Some e' => fe_subbody (Δ ++ T) e' ip' | None => None end
      end
  | fe_ind _ _ _ D t' =>
      match ip with
      | nil => Some (ind_uparams D, t')
      | z :: ip' => match ft_find t' z with Some e' => fe_subbody (ind_uparams D) e' ip' | None => None end
      end
  | fe_record _ p R t' =>
      match ip with
      | nil => Some (record_mod_tele p R, t')
      | z :: ip' => match ft_find t' z with Some e' => fe_subbody (record_mod_tele p R) e' ip' | None => None end
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

gm_subbody's twin
Definition ft_subbody (T : ctx) (t : ftrie) (x : string) (ip : list string) : option (ctx * ftrie) :=
  match ft_find t x with
  | Some e => fe_subbody T e ip
  | None => None
  end.

gm_subbody reads the newest entry of the name.
Lemma gm_subbody_newest : forall Φ T x ip,
    gm_subbody T Φ x ip =
      match gm_newest Φ x with
      | Some (ge_mod _ (gu_mk Δ (md_body sm Φ'))) =>
          match ip with
          | nil => Some (Δ ++ T, Φ')
          | z :: ip' => gm_subbody (Δ ++ T) Φ' z ip'
          end
      | Some (ge_ind _ _ _ D Φ') =>
          match ip with
          | nil => Some (ind_uparams D, Φ')
          | z :: ip' => gm_subbody (ind_uparams D) Φ' z ip'
          end
      | Some (ge_record _ p R Φ') =>
          match ip with
          | nil => Some (record_mod_tele p R, Φ')
          | z :: ip' => gm_subbody (record_mod_tele p R) Φ' z ip'
          end
      | _ => None
      end.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its Φg IHg]; intros T x ip; cbn [gm_subbody gm_newest].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (String.eqb x y); [ destruct E as [| ? [? [] ] | | |]; reflexivity | apply IH ].
  - apply IH.
Qed.

The trie finds the translation of the body gm_subbody finds.
Theorem ft_subbody_ok : forall ip Φ T x, canon_mod Φ -> ft_subbody T (translate_mod Φ) x ip = option_map translate_loc (gm_subbody T Φ x ip).
Proof.
  induction ip as [| z ip IH]; intros Φ T x Hc; unfold ft_subbody; rewrite translate_mod_find, gm_subbody_newest;
    destruct (gm_newest Φ x) as [E |] eqn:En; cbn [option_map]; try reflexivity;
    pose proof (canon_newest _ _ _ Hc En) as HE;
    destruct E as [b pv r A oM | pv [Δ [[|] Φ' | E']] | pv pq k D Φ' | pv A M [Δ [[|] Φ' | E']] | pv p R Φ'];
    cbn in HE; try contradiction; try reflexivity;
    cbn [translate_entry translate_unit fe_subbody]; rewrite <- IH by exact HE; reflexivity.
Qed.

What gm_subbody finds in a canonical body is canonical.
Lemma canon_subbody : forall ip Φ T x T' Φ', canon_mod Φ -> gm_subbody T Φ x ip = Some (T', Φ') -> canon_mod Φ'.
Proof.
  induction ip as [| z ip IH]; intros Φ T x T' Φ' Hc Hs; rewrite gm_subbody_newest in Hs;
    destruct (gm_newest Φ x) as [E |] eqn:En; try discriminate;
    pose proof (canon_newest _ _ _ Hc En) as HE;
    destruct E as [b pv r A oM | pv [Δ [[|] Φ1 | E']] | pv pq k D Φ1 | pv A M U | pv p R Φ1];
    cbn in HE; try contradiction; try discriminate;
    first [ injection Hs as _ <-; exact HE | exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ HE Hs) ].
Qed.

What gm_entry finds in a canonical body is canonical.
Lemma canon_gm_entry : forall ip Φ E, canon_mod Φ -> gm_entry Φ ip = Some E -> canon_entry E.
Proof.
  induction ip as [| x ip IH]; intros Φ E Hc He; [ rewrite gm_entry_nil in He; discriminate |].
  rewrite gm_entry_newest in He; destruct (gm_newest Φ x) as [E' |] eqn:En; [| discriminate ].
  pose proof (canon_newest _ _ _ Hc En) as HE'.
  destruct ip as [| z ip']; [ injection He as <-; exact HE' |].
  destruct (entry_body E') eqn:Eb; [| discriminate ]; exact (IH _ _ (canon_entry_body _ _ HE' Eb) He).
Qed.

gm_body's twin
Definition ft_body (T : ctx) (t : ftrie) (ip : list string) : option (ctx * ftrie) :=
  match ip with
  | nil => Some (T, t)
  | x :: ip' => ft_subbody T t x ip'
  end.

Alike for gm_body
Lemma ft_body_ok : forall T Φ ip, canon_mod Φ -> ft_body T (translate_mod Φ) ip = option_map translate_loc (gm_body T Φ ip).
Proof. intros T Φ [| x ip] Hc; [ reflexivity | apply ft_subbody_ok, Hc ]. Qed.

What gm_body finds in a canonical body is canonical.
Lemma canon_body : forall ip Φ T T' Φ', canon_mod Φ -> gm_body T Φ ip = Some (T', Φ') -> canon_mod Φ'.
Proof. intros [| x ip] * Hc Hb; [ injection Hb as _ <-; exact Hc | exact (canon_subbody _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hb) ]. Qed.

Through the Context

The units by a function uf : path -> option funit, the frames fast.
Section Lookups.
  Variable uf : path -> option funit.

gc_resolve's twin
  Definition fast_gc_resolve (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option gentry :=
    match fs_find fs p with
    | Some (f, ip) => ft_resolve (ff_body f) ip
    | None =>
        match uf (q_unit p) with
        | Some u => ft_resolve (fu_body u) (q_chain p)
        | None => None
        end
    end.

gc_module's twin
  Definition fast_gc_module (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option modres :=
    match fs_find_tele fs p with
    | Some (f, nil, _) => None
    | Some (f, x :: ip, T) => ft_submodule (ff_params f ++ T) (ff_body f) x ip
    | None =>
        match uf (q_unit p) with
        | Some u => ft_module (fu_params u) None (fu_body u) (q_chain p)
        | None => None
        end
    end.

gc_body's twin
  Definition fast_gc_body (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option (ctx * ftrie) :=
    match fs_find_tele fs p with
    | Some (f, nil, _) => None
    | Some (f, x :: ip, T) => ft_subbody (ff_params f ++ T) (ff_body f) x ip
    | None =>
        match uf (q_unit p) with
        | Some u => ft_body (fu_params u) (fu_body u) (q_chain p)
        | None => None
        end
    end.

gc_frame's twin: every fast frame is a closed body.
  Definition fast_gc_frame (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option (ctx * ftrie) :=
    match fs_find_tele fs p with
    | Some (f, nil, T0) => Some (ff_params f ++ T0, ff_body f)
    | _ => None
    end.

gc_loc's twin
  Definition fast_gc_loc (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option (ctx * ftrie) :=
    match fast_gc_frame fs p with
    | Some r => Some r
    | None => fast_gc_body fs p
    end.

ind_mlookup's twin
  Definition fast_gc_mlookup (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option indref :=
    match fs_find_ind fs p with
    | Some r => Some r
    | None =>
        match fast_gc_module fs p with
        | Some (mr_body _ oD) => oD
        | _ => None
        end
    end.

ind_lookup's twin
  Definition fast_gc_ind (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option ind_decl := ind_of_ref (fast_gc_mlookup fs p).

gc_entry's twin
  Definition fast_gc_entry (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option fentry :=
    match fs_find fs p with
    | Some (f, ip) => ft_entry (ff_body f) ip
    | None =>
        match uf (q_unit p) with
        | Some u => ft_entry (fu_body u) (q_chain p)
        | None => None
        end
    end.

record_lookup's twin
  Definition fast_gc_record (fs : fstack) (p : qname) : option record_decl :=
    match fs_find_record fs p with
    | Some R => Some R
    | None =>
        match fast_gc_entry fs p with
        | Some (fe_record _ _ R _) => Some R
        | _ => None
        end
    end.

gc_unit's twin
  Definition fast_gc_unit (fs : fstack) (H : modexp) : option (ctx * ftrie) :=
    match mod_qname H with
    | Some mp =>
        match fs_find_tele fs mp with
        | Some (f, nil, T0) =>
            match fs_find_ind fs mp, fs_find_record fs mp with
            | None, None => Some (ff_params f ++ T0, ff_body f)
            | _, _ => None
            end
        | Some _ => None
        | None =>
            match q_chain mp, uf (q_unit mp) with
            | nil, Some (fu_mk Δ (fmd_body t)) => Some (Δ, t)
            | _, _ => None
            end
        end
    | None => None
    end.
End Lookups.

The body of a canonical frame is canonical.
Lemma canon_frame_mod : forall U, canon_frame U -> canon_mod (gu_mod U).
Proof. intros [Δ [[|] Φ | E]] H; cbn in *; tauto. Qed.

The body of a canonical unit is canonical.
Lemma canon_unit_mod : forall U, canon_unit U -> canon_mod (gu_mod U).
Proof. intros [Δ [[|] Φ | E]] H; cbn in *; tauto. Qed.

The frame a path is in, in a canonical stack, is canonical.
Lemma canon_gs_find_tele : forall Ξ p U ip T, canon_stack Ξ -> gs_find_tele Ξ p = Some (U, ip, T) -> canon_frame U.
Proof.
  intros Ξ p U ip T H; induction H as [| [[mp K] U'] Ξ HU _ IH]; cbn; [ discriminate |].
  destruct (qname_strip mp p); [ intros [= <- _ _]; exact HU | exact IH ].
Qed.

Alike for gs_find
Lemma canon_gs_find : forall Ξ p U ip, canon_stack Ξ -> gs_find Ξ p = Some (U, ip) -> canon_frame U.
Proof.
  intros * Hc Hf; rewrite gs_find_tele_find in Hf.
  destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U' ip'] T] |] eqn:E; cbn in Hf; [| discriminate ]; injection Hf as -> ->.
  exact (canon_gs_find_tele _ _ _ _ _ Hc E).
Qed.

Restricting canonical units keeps them canonical.
Lemma canon_restrict : forall S Θ, canon_deps Θ -> canon_deps (gds_restrict S Θ).
Proof.
  intros S; induction Θ as [| [fp U] Θ IH]; intros Hc; [ exact I |]; unfold gds_restrict in *; cbn [filter fst] in *.
  destruct Hc as (Hn & HU & Hc).
  destruct (existsb (path_beq fp) S); [ cbn; split; [| split; [ exact HU | exact (IH Hc) ] ] | exact (IH Hc) ].
  fold (gds_restrict S Θ); rewrite gds_lookup_restrict, Hn; destruct (existsb _ _); reflexivity.
Qed.

On the translation of a canonical Core context, the twins find what the Core lookups find, translated.
Section LookupsOk.
  Variables (uf : path -> option funit) (Θ : gdeps).
  Hypothesis Huf : forall fp, uf fp = option_map translate_unit (gds_lookup Θ fp).
  Hypothesis HcΘ : canon_deps Θ.

A unit found is canonical.
  Lemma canon_found : forall fp U, gds_lookup Θ fp = Some U -> canon_mod (gu_mod U).
  Proof. intros * H; exact (canon_unit_mod _ (canon_deps_lookup _ _ _ HcΘ H)). Qed.

  Lemma fs_find_some : forall Ξ p,
      match fs_find (fs_of Ξ) p, gs_find Ξ p with
      | Some (f, ip), Some (U, ip') => ff_body f = translate_mod (gu_mod U) /\ ip = ip'
      | None, None => True
      | _, _ => False
      end.
  Proof.
    intros Ξ p; pose proof (fs_find_of Ξ p) as H.
    destruct (fs_find (fs_of Ξ) p) as [[f ip] |], (gs_find Ξ p) as [[U ip'] |]; cbn in H; try discriminate; auto.
    injection H as -> ->; auto.
  Qed.

  Lemma fs_find_tele_some : forall Ξ p,
      match fs_find_tele (fs_of Ξ) p, gs_find_tele Ξ p with
      | Some (f, ip, T), Some (U, ip', T') => ff_params f = gu_params U /\ ff_body f = translate_mod (gu_mod U) /\ ip = ip' /\ T = T'
      | None, None => True
      | _, _ => False
      end.
  Proof.
    intros Ξ p; pose proof (fs_find_tele_of Ξ p) as H.
    destruct (fs_find_tele (fs_of Ξ) p) as [[[f ip] T] |], (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U ip'] T'] |];
      cbn in H; try discriminate; auto.
    injection H as -> -> -> ->; auto.
  Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_module_ok : forall Ξ p, canon_stack Ξ -> fast_gc_module uf (fs_of Ξ) p = gc_module Θ Ξ p.
  Proof.
    intros Ξ p HcΞ; unfold fast_gc_module, gc_module, gc_module_u.
    pose proof (fs_find_tele_some Ξ p) as H.
    destruct (fs_find_tele (fs_of Ξ) p) as [[[f ip] T] |], (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U ip'] T'] |] eqn:Eg; try contradiction.
    - destruct H as (-> & -> & <- & <-); destruct ip; [ reflexivity |].
      apply ft_submodule_ok, canon_frame_mod, (canon_gs_find_tele _ _ _ _ _ HcΞ Eg).
    - rewrite Huf; destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:El; cbn [option_map]; [| reflexivity ].
      rewrite translate_unit_body, translate_unit_params by exact (canon_deps_lookup _ _ _ HcΘ El); apply ft_module_ok, (canon_found _ _ El).
  Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_body_ok : forall Ξ p, canon_stack Ξ -> fast_gc_body uf (fs_of Ξ) p = option_map translate_loc (gc_body Θ Ξ p).
  Proof.
    intros Ξ p HcΞ; unfold fast_gc_body, gc_body.
    pose proof (fs_find_tele_some Ξ p) as H.
    destruct (fs_find_tele (fs_of Ξ) p) as [[[f ip] T] |], (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U ip'] T'] |] eqn:Eg; try contradiction.
    - destruct H as (-> & -> & <- & <-); destruct ip; [ reflexivity |].
      apply ft_subbody_ok, canon_frame_mod, (canon_gs_find_tele _ _ _ _ _ HcΞ Eg).
    - rewrite Huf; destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:El; cbn [option_map]; [| reflexivity ].
      rewrite translate_unit_body, translate_unit_params by exact (canon_deps_lookup _ _ _ HcΘ El); apply ft_body_ok, (canon_found _ _ El).
  Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_frame_ok : forall Ξ p, stack_closed Ξ -> fast_gc_frame (fs_of Ξ) p = option_map translate_loc (gc_frame Ξ p).
  Proof.
    induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros p Hc; [ reflexivity |].
    inversion Hc as [| ? ? HU Hc']; subst; cbn in HU.
    unfold fast_gc_frame, gc_frame in *; cbn [fs_of map translate_frame fs_find_tele gs_find_tele ff_path].
    destruct (qname_strip mp p) as [[| x ip] |].
    - destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ | E]]; cbn in HU |- *; try contradiction; rewrite fs_tele_of; reflexivity.
    - destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ | E]]; reflexivity.
    - exact (IH p Hc').
  Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_loc_ok : forall Ξ p, canon_stack Ξ -> fast_gc_loc uf (fs_of Ξ) p = option_map translate_loc (gc_loc Θ Ξ p).
  Proof.
    intros * Hc; unfold fast_gc_loc, gc_loc; rewrite fast_gc_frame_ok by exact (canon_stack_closed _ Hc).
    destruct (gc_frame Ξ p); [ reflexivity | apply fast_gc_body_ok, Hc ].
  Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_mlookup_ok : forall Ξ p, canon_stack Ξ -> fast_gc_mlookup uf (fs_of Ξ) p = ind_mlookup Θ Ξ p.
  Proof.
    intros * Hc; unfold fast_gc_mlookup, ind_mlookup, ind_mlookup_u; rewrite fs_find_ind_of.
    destruct (gs_find_ind Ξ p); [ reflexivity |].
    rewrite fast_gc_module_ok by exact Hc; reflexivity.
  Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_ind_ok : forall Ξ p, canon_stack Ξ -> fast_gc_ind uf (fs_of Ξ) p = ind_lookup Θ Ξ p.
  Proof. intros * Hc; unfold fast_gc_ind, ind_lookup, ind_lookup_u; rewrite fast_gc_mlookup_ok by exact Hc; reflexivity. Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_entry_ok : forall Ξ p, canon_stack Ξ -> fast_gc_entry uf (fs_of Ξ) p = option_map translate_entry (gc_entry Θ Ξ p).
  Proof.
    intros Ξ p HcΞ; unfold fast_gc_entry, gc_entry, gc_entry_u.
    pose proof (fs_find_some Ξ p) as H.
    destruct (fs_find (fs_of Ξ) p) as [[f ip] |], (gs_find Ξ p) as [[U ip'] |] eqn:Eg; try contradiction.
    - destruct H as [-> ->]; apply ft_entry_ok, canon_frame_mod, (canon_gs_find _ _ _ _ HcΞ Eg).
    - rewrite Huf; destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:El; cbn [option_map]; [| reflexivity ].
      rewrite translate_unit_body by exact (canon_deps_lookup _ _ _ HcΘ El); apply ft_entry_ok, (canon_found _ _ El).
  Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_record_ok : forall Ξ p, canon_stack Ξ -> fast_gc_record uf (fs_of Ξ) p = record_lookup Θ Ξ p.
  Proof.
    intros * Hc; unfold fast_gc_record, record_lookup; rewrite fs_find_record_of, fast_gc_entry_ok by exact Hc.
    destruct (gs_find_record Ξ p); [ reflexivity |].
    destruct (gc_entry Θ Ξ p) as [[| | | | ] |]; reflexivity.
  Qed.

  Theorem fast_gc_unit_ok : forall Ξ H, canon_stack Ξ -> fast_gc_unit uf (fs_of Ξ) H = option_map translate_loc (gc_unit Θ Ξ H).
  Proof.
    intros * Hc0; pose proof (canon_stack_closed _ Hc0) as Hc; unfold fast_gc_unit, gc_unit.
    destruct (mod_qname H) as [mp |]; [| reflexivity ].
    rewrite fs_find_ind_of, fs_find_record_of.
    destruct (fs_find_tele (fs_of Ξ) mp) as [[[f ip] T] |] eqn:Ef.
    - destruct (fs_find_tele_kind _ _ _ _ _ Ef) as (mq & U & T' & Eg & ->).
      pose proof (fs_find_tele_some Ξ mp) as Hs; rewrite Ef, Eg in Hs.
      destruct Hs as (_ & _ & _ & ->); rewrite Eg.
      assert (HU : frame_closed U).
      { clear -Hc Eg; induction Hc as [| [[mp' K'] U'] Ξ HU' _ IH]; cbn in Eg; [ discriminate |].
        destruct (qname_strip mp' mp); [ injection Eg as -> _ _; exact HU' | exact (IH Eg) ]. }
      destruct ip as [| x ip]; [| reflexivity ].
      destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ | E]]; cbn in HU; try contradiction; cbn [translate_frame ff_params ff_body gu_params gu_mod].
      destruct (gs_find_ind Ξ mp), (gs_find_record Ξ mp); reflexivity.
    - pose proof (fs_find_tele_some Ξ mp) as Hs; rewrite Ef in Hs.
      destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ mp) as [[[U ip] T] |]; [ contradiction |].
      rewrite Huf; destruct (q_chain mp); [| reflexivity ].
      destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit mp)) as [[Δ [[|] Φ | E]] |]; reflexivity.
  Qed.
End LookupsOk.

Well-Formed Contexts Are Canonical

Freshness (wf_gmod_ext, wf_gstack_file) and the absence of local opens in global bodies make every filed unit and every open frame canonical, so decoding undoes the translation on them.
Lemma canon_of_wf_gmod :
  (forall Θ Ξ mp E, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> canon_entry E) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> canon_mod Φ).
Proof.
  apply global_wf_mut_ind; intros; cbn; auto.
Qed.

A well-formed global context is canonical.
Theorem canon_of_wf : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> canon_deps Θ /\ canon_stack Ξ.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ H; induction H as [| Θ fp U H [IHΘ IHΞ] | Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ H [IHΘ IHΞ] HΦ Hfr].
  - split; [ exact I | constructor ].
  - destruct (wf_gstack_file_inv Θ fp U (wf_gstack_file _ _ _ H)) as [_ _ Hn _].
    inversion IHΞ as [| ? ? HU _]; subst.
    split; [ cbn; split; [ exact Hn | split; [| exact IHΘ ] ] | constructor ].
    destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ | E]]; cbn in HU |- *; tauto.
  - split; [ exact IHΘ | constructor; [ exact (proj2 canon_of_wf_gmod _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ) | exact IHΞ ] ].
Qed.

What Canonical Contexts Find Is Canonical


Section CanonLookups.
  Variables (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack).
  Hypotheses (HcΘ : canon_deps Θ) (HcΞ : canon_stack Ξ).

An entry found
  Lemma canon_gc_entry : forall p E, gc_entry Θ Ξ p = Some E -> canon_entry E.
  Proof.
    intros * He; unfold gc_entry, gc_entry_u in He.
    destruct (gs_find Ξ p) as [[U ip] |] eqn:Eg.
    - exact (canon_gm_entry _ _ _ (canon_frame_mod _ (canon_gs_find _ _ _ _ HcΞ Eg)) He).
    - destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:El; [| discriminate ].
      exact (canon_gm_entry _ _ _ (canon_unit_mod _ (canon_deps_lookup _ _ _ HcΘ El)) He).
  Qed.

A body module found
  Lemma canon_gc_body : forall p T Φ, gc_body Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> canon_mod Φ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hb; unfold gc_body in Hb.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U [| x ip]] T0] |] eqn:Eg; [ discriminate | |].
    - exact (canon_subbody _ _ _ _ _ _ (canon_frame_mod _ (canon_gs_find_tele _ _ _ _ _ HcΞ Eg)) Hb).
    - destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit p)) as [U |] eqn:El; [| discriminate ].
      exact (canon_body _ _ _ _ _ (canon_unit_mod _ (canon_deps_lookup _ _ _ HcΘ El)) Hb).
  Qed.

An open frame found
  Lemma canon_gc_frame : forall p T Φ, gc_frame Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> canon_mod Φ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hf; unfold gc_frame in Hf.
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[[Δ [[|] Φ0 | E]] [| x ip]] T0] |] eqn:Eg; try discriminate.
    injection Hf as _ <-; exact (canon_frame_mod _ (canon_gs_find_tele _ _ _ _ _ HcΞ Eg)).
  Qed.

Where a module is stored
  Lemma canon_gc_loc : forall p T Φ, gc_loc Θ Ξ p = Some (T, Φ) -> canon_mod Φ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl; unfold gc_loc in Hl.
    destruct (gc_frame Ξ p) as [[T0 Φ0] |] eqn:Ef; [ injection Hl as _ <-; exact (canon_gc_frame _ _ _ Ef) |].
    exact (canon_gc_body _ _ _ Hl).
  Qed.

A stored unit found
  Lemma canon_gc_unit : forall H T Φ, gc_unit Θ Ξ H = Some (T, Φ) -> canon_mod Φ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hu; unfold gc_unit in Hu.
    destruct (mod_qname H) as [mp |]; [| discriminate ].
    destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ mp) as [[[U [| x ip]] T0] |] eqn:Eg; try discriminate.
    - destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ0 | E]], (gs_find_ind Ξ mp), (gs_find_record Ξ mp); try discriminate.
      injection Hu as _ <-; exact (canon_frame_mod _ (canon_gs_find_tele _ _ _ _ _ HcΞ Eg)).
    - destruct (q_chain mp); [| discriminate ].
      destruct (gds_lookup Θ (q_unit mp)) as [[Δ [[|] Φ0 | E]] |] eqn:El; try discriminate.
      injection Hu as _ <-; exact (canon_unit_mod _ (canon_deps_lookup _ _ _ HcΘ El)).
  Qed.
End CanonLookups.

A located body, decoded
Definition decode_loc (r : (ctx * ftrie)%type) : (ctx * gmod)%type := (fst r, decode_mod (snd r)).

Decoding undoes the translation of a canonical located body.
Lemma decode_translate_loc : forall r, canon_mod (snd r) -> decode_loc (translate_loc r) = r.
Proof. intros [T Φ] H; unfold decode_loc, translate_loc; cbn in *; rewrite decode_translate_mod by exact H; reflexivity. Qed.

Forgetting the Stored Values

The values a definition's entry stores (fe_def, fe_def_mod) are what the fast data has beyond the Core data it stands for: dropping them (fentry_drop and the like) gives fast data that is the translation of its decoding, which is the refinement the invariants state (units_rep, fs_of). Decoding forgets them anyway (decode_entry_drop), and every fast lookup commutes with dropping (fast_gc_entry_drop and the like). The executable drops them once, at the end of a program's run.
Every stored value set to None
Fixpoint funit_drop (u : funit) : funit :=
  match u with
  | fu_mk Δ D => fu_mk Δ (fmoddef_drop D)
  | fu_core U => fu_core U
  end
with fmoddef_drop (D : fmoddef) : fmoddef :=
  match D with
  | fmd_body t => fmd_body (ftrie_drop t)
  end
with ftrie_drop (t : ftrie) : ftrie :=
  match t with
  | ft_mk m xs => ft_mk (SRaw.map fentry_drop m) xs
  end
with fentry_drop (e : fentry) : fentry :=
  match e with
  | fe_def b pv r A oM _ => fe_def b pv r A oM None
  | fe_mod pv u => fe_mod pv (funit_drop u)
  | fe_ind pv pq k D t => fe_ind pv pq k D (ftrie_drop t)
  | fe_def_mod pv A M u _ => fe_def_mod pv A M (funit_drop u) None
  | fe_record pv p R t => fe_record pv p R (ftrie_drop t)
  end.

A located body, its values dropped
Definition loc_drop (r : (ctx * ftrie)%type) : (ctx * ftrie)%type := (fst r, ftrie_drop (snd r)).

Trees


Lemma sraw_map_height : forall {A B} (f : A -> B) m, SRaw.height (SRaw.map f m) = SRaw.height m.
Proof. intros A B f [| l x e r h]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sraw_map_create : forall {A B} (f : A -> B) l x e r,
    SRaw.map f (SRaw.create l x e r) = SRaw.create (SRaw.map f l) x (f e) (SRaw.map f r).
Proof. intros; unfold SRaw.create; cbn; rewrite !sraw_map_height; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sraw_map_bal : forall {A B} (f : A -> B) l x e r,
    SRaw.map f (SRaw.bal l x e r) = SRaw.bal (SRaw.map f l) x (f e) (SRaw.map f r).
Proof.
  intros; unfold SRaw.bal; rewrite !sraw_map_height.
  destruct (Int.Z_as_Int.gt_le_dec _ _).
  - destruct l as [| ll lx ld lr lh]; [ exact (sraw_map_create f _ x e r) |].
    cbn [SRaw.map]; rewrite !sraw_map_height.
    destruct (Int.Z_as_Int.ge_lt_dec _ _); [ rewrite !sraw_map_create; reflexivity |].
    destruct lr as [| lrl lrx lrd lrr lrh]; [ exact (sraw_map_create f _ x e r) |].
    cbn [SRaw.map]; rewrite !sraw_map_create; reflexivity.
  - destruct (Int.Z_as_Int.gt_le_dec _ _).
    + destruct r as [| rl rx rd rr rh]; [ exact (sraw_map_create f l x e _) |].
      cbn [SRaw.map]; rewrite !sraw_map_height.
      destruct (Int.Z_as_Int.ge_lt_dec _ _); [ rewrite !sraw_map_create; reflexivity |].
      destruct rl as [| rll rlx rld rlr rlh]; [ exact (sraw_map_create f l x e _) |].
      cbn [SRaw.map]; rewrite !sraw_map_create; reflexivity.
    + apply sraw_map_create.
Qed.

Lemma sraw_map_add : forall {A B} (f : A -> B) x e m, SRaw.map f (SRaw.add x e m) = SRaw.add x (f e) (SRaw.map f m).
Proof.
  intros A B f x e; induction m as [| l IHl y d r IHr h]; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct (OrderedTypeEx.String_as_OT.compare x y); cbn; rewrite ?sraw_map_bal, ?IHl, ?IHr; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma string_tree_find_map : forall {A B} (f : A -> B) x m, string_tree_find x (SRaw.map f m) = option_map f (string_tree_find x m).
Proof. intros A B f x; induction m as [| l IHl y d r IHr h]; cbn; [ reflexivity |]; destruct (String.compare x y); auto. Qed.

Decoding Forgets the Values


Fixpoint decode_unit_drop (u : funit) : decode_unit (funit_drop u) = decode_unit u
with decode_mod_drop (t : ftrie) : decode_mod (ftrie_drop t) = decode_mod t
with decode_entry_drop (e : fentry) : decode_entry (fentry_drop e) = decode_entry e.
Proof.
  - destruct u as [Δ [t] | U]; cbn [funit_drop fmoddef_drop decode_unit]; [ rewrite decode_mod_drop |]; reflexivity.
  - destruct t as [m xs]; cbn [ftrie_drop]; rewrite !decode_mod_unfold; f_equal.
    revert m; fix IHm 1; intros [| l k e r h]; cbn [SRaw.map decode_tree_with]; [ reflexivity |].
    rewrite (IHm l), (IHm r), (decode_entry_drop e); reflexivity.
  - destruct e; cbn [fentry_drop decode_entry]; rewrite ?decode_unit_drop, ?decode_mod_drop; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma decode_loc_drop : forall r, decode_loc (loc_drop r) = decode_loc r.
Proof. intros [T t]; unfold decode_loc, loc_drop; cbn; rewrite decode_mod_drop; reflexivity. Qed.

A Translation Stores No Value


Lemma ftrie_drop_ext : forall t x e, ftrie_drop (ft_ext t x e) = ft_ext (ftrie_drop t) x (fentry_drop e).
Proof. intros [m xs] x e; cbn; rewrite sraw_map_add; reflexivity. Qed.

Fixpoint translate_unit_drop (U : gunit) : funit_drop (translate_unit U) = translate_unit U
with translate_mod_drop (Φ : gmod) : ftrie_drop (translate_mod Φ) = translate_mod Φ
with translate_entry_drop (E : gentry) : fentry_drop (translate_entry E) = translate_entry E.
Proof.
  - destruct U as [Δ [[|] Φ | H]]; cbn [translate_unit funit_drop fmoddef_drop]; rewrite ?translate_mod_drop; reflexivity.
  - destruct Φ as [| Φ x E | Φ H its]; cbn [translate_mod]; [ reflexivity | | apply translate_mod_drop ].
    rewrite ftrie_drop_ext, translate_mod_drop, translate_entry_drop; reflexivity.
  - destruct E; cbn [translate_entry fentry_drop]; rewrite ?translate_unit_drop, ?translate_mod_drop; reflexivity.
Qed.

The Lookups in a Body Commute with Dropping


Lemma ft_find_drop : forall t x, ft_find (ftrie_drop t) x = option_map fentry_drop (ft_find t x).
Proof. intros [m xs] x; unfold ft_find; cbn; apply string_tree_find_map. Qed.

Lemma fe_body_drop : forall e, fe_body (fentry_drop e) = option_map ftrie_drop (fe_body e).
Proof. intros [| ? [? [?] | ?] | | | ]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ft_entry_drop : forall ip t, ft_entry (ftrie_drop t) ip = option_map fentry_drop (ft_entry t ip).
Proof.
  induction ip as [| x ip IH]; intros t; cbn [ft_entry]; [ reflexivity |].
  rewrite ft_find_drop; destruct (ft_find t x) as [e |]; cbn [option_map]; [| reflexivity ].
  destruct ip as [| y ip']; [ reflexivity |].
  rewrite fe_body_drop; destruct (fe_body e); cbn [option_map]; [ apply IH | reflexivity ].
Qed.

Lemma fu_params_drop : forall u, fu_params (funit_drop u) = fu_params u.
Proof. intros [? [?] | ?]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fu_body_drop : forall u, fu_body (funit_drop u) = ftrie_drop (fu_body u).
Proof. intros [? [?] | ?]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fe_submodule_drop : forall ip T e, fe_submodule T (fentry_drop e) ip = fe_submodule T e ip.
Proof.
  induction ip as [| z ip IH]; intros T e;
    destruct e as [| ? [? [t'] | [? [? ? | ?]]] | ? ? ? ? t' | ? ? ? [? [t'] | [? [? ? | ?]]] ? | ? ? ? t'];
    cbn [fe_submodule fentry_drop funit_drop fmoddef_drop]; try reflexivity;
    rewrite ft_find_drop; destruct (ft_find t' z); cbn [option_map]; try reflexivity; apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma ft_submodule_drop : forall T t x ip, ft_submodule T (ftrie_drop t) x ip = ft_submodule T t x ip.
Proof.
  intros; unfold ft_submodule; rewrite ft_find_drop; destruct (ft_find t x); cbn [option_map]; [ apply fe_submodule_drop | reflexivity ].
Qed.

Lemma ft_module_drop : forall T oD t ip, ft_module T oD (ftrie_drop t) ip = ft_module T oD t ip.
Proof. intros T oD t [| x ip]; [ reflexivity | apply ft_submodule_drop ]. Qed.

Lemma fe_subbody_drop : forall ip T e, fe_subbody T (fentry_drop e) ip = option_map loc_drop (fe_subbody T e ip).
Proof.
  induction ip as [| z ip IH]; intros T e;
    destruct e as [| ? [? [t'] | ?] | ? ? ? ? t' | ? ? ? [? [t'] | ?] ? | ? ? ? t'];
    cbn [fe_subbody fentry_drop funit_drop fmoddef_drop]; try reflexivity;
    rewrite ft_find_drop; destruct (ft_find t' z); cbn [option_map]; try reflexivity; apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma ft_subbody_drop : forall T t x ip, ft_subbody T (ftrie_drop t) x ip = option_map loc_drop (ft_subbody T t x ip).
Proof.
  intros; unfold ft_subbody; rewrite ft_find_drop; destruct (ft_find t x); cbn [option_map]; [ apply fe_subbody_drop | reflexivity ].
Qed.

Lemma ft_body_drop : forall T t ip, ft_body T (ftrie_drop t) ip = option_map loc_drop (ft_body T t ip).
Proof. intros T t [| x ip]; [ reflexivity | apply ft_subbody_drop ]. Qed.

Frames

A frame, its values dropped
Definition fframe_drop (f : fframe) : fframe := mk_fframe (ff_path f) (ff_kind f) (ff_params f) (ftrie_drop (ff_body f)).

The frames, their values dropped
Definition fstack_drop (fs : fstack) : fstack := map fframe_drop fs.

Lemma decode_stack_drop : forall fs, decode_stack (fstack_drop fs) = decode_stack fs.
Proof.
  unfold decode_stack, fstack_drop; induction fs as [| f fs IH]; [ reflexivity |]; cbn [map] in *.
  unfold decode_frame, fframe_drop; cbn [ff_path ff_kind ff_params ff_body]; rewrite decode_mod_drop.
  f_equal; exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma fs_of_drop : forall Ξ, fstack_drop (fs_of Ξ) = fs_of Ξ.
Proof.
  unfold fs_of, fstack_drop; induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; [ reflexivity |]; cbn [map] in *.
  unfold translate_frame, fframe_drop; cbn [ff_path ff_kind ff_params ff_body]; rewrite translate_mod_drop.
  f_equal; exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma fs_tele_drop : forall fs, fs_tele (fstack_drop fs) = fs_tele fs.
Proof. unfold fstack_drop; induction fs as [| f fs IH]; [ reflexivity |]; cbn [map fs_tele] in *; rewrite IH; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fs_add_drop : forall x e fs, fstack_drop (fs_add x e fs) = fs_add x (fentry_drop e) (fstack_drop fs).
Proof. intros x e [| f fs]; [ reflexivity |]; cbn; unfold fframe_drop; cbn; rewrite ftrie_drop_ext; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fs_fresh_dec_drop : forall x fs, fs_fresh_dec x (fstack_drop fs) = fs_fresh_dec x fs.
Proof.
  intros x [| f fs]; [ reflexivity |]; cbn; unfold fframe_drop; cbn [ff_body].
  rewrite ft_find_drop; destruct (ft_find (ff_body f) x); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma fs_find_tele_drop : forall fs p,
    fs_find_tele (fstack_drop fs) p = option_map (fun r => let '(f, ip, T) := r in (fframe_drop f, ip, T)) (fs_find_tele fs p).
Proof.
  induction fs as [| f fs IH]; intros p; [ reflexivity |].
  change (fstack_drop (f :: fs)) with (fframe_drop f :: fstack_drop fs); cbn [fs_find_tele].
